_source.title: 获取圆弧
_source.params.primitiveIds: 圆弧的图元 ID，可以为字符串或字符串数组，如若为数组，则返回的也是数组

title: Get Arc
params.primitiveIds: Arc primitive ID, which can be a string or an array of strings. If it is an array, an array is also returned
returns: Arc primitive object, `undefined` indicates that the retrieval failed
